title: Explorer v0: automated two-level search (casts x operators) with a lab notebook and blind A/B
description: The product owner wants an automated scientific process to explore a score's solution space. Inner loop: fix a cast with typed operators proposed from the checker's findings (bass root/octave, notches from the notch-finder, transposition, hp/filter, release, volume), a coordinate hill-climb, accepted only if it improves on a training bar-window, doesn't worsen a held-out window, and adds no new guard violation. Outer loop: casts (role -> sample+clip) as hypotheses, run by successive halving over one eval pool (4 workers), with a diversity rule. Pre-registration of explain predictions, an incumbent control, a determinism check, a JSONL notebook, a leaderboard and promoted best.apr/m4a, blind A/B pairs with Bradley-Terry calibration later, and chord substitutions only with user approval. Positive controls: rediscover root Ab1; revert an injected transpose 1; beat a random-operator control. Prerequisites: the checker's tuning guard excludes unpitched stems, and the baseline is refreshed per run from the incumbent. Design: Fable report from the session (2026-09-27); v0 is on examples/ave-house.apr, role bright, 12 candidates.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Human in the loop, per the product owner (2026-09-27): overnight runs; the owner wakes to THREE diverse finalists (different casts, not three tweaks of one) plus the incumbent. Morning report: best-1..3.m4a with attribution, and a private claude.ai listening artifact (a db capability) where they rate each 1-5 stars, pick the best, and add a note. The next session reads the ratings back and appends them to notebook.jsonl as verdicts (kind ab-pair / rating), then seeds the next run from the favourite. Ratings also calibrate the checker over time (Bradley-Terry, agreement rate).
